I'm sorry about the double charge, that's frustrating. I can't see your account, so I can't fix the charge myself, but the billing team can look into it and correct it.

Please email billing@lumen.io with:
- The account email you use with Lumen
- The dates and amounts of both charges (screenshots of your bank or card statement are helpful, but please don't include full card numbers)

Please don't share card numbers, bank details or passwords in chat or by email.
